name: After recital T
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Tb. whereas if genuine convergence in economic and social progress between Member States is to be achieved, the redistributive function of the EU multiannual budget needs to be bolstered and that budget needs to be stepped up significantly; whereas an amount equivalent to 2 % of the gross national income of Member States is the appropriate benchmark for the pursuit of those objectives and for fostering the full use of resources and productive capacities and the development potential of each country, through public investment in, support for and modernisation of productive and strategic sectors, through investment in, modernisation and improvement of the quality of public services, through the creation of rights-based jobs and fostering of full employment, through efforts to eradicate poverty, social exclusion and inequalities, through the preservation and restoration of ecosystems, through the mitigation of and adaptation to climate change, and through the building of external relationships based on solidarity, cooperation, mutual respect and peace;
